title: Mu Gu and the Chairman
summary: While Xiao Yan trains his Soul Skill, Mu Gu, an Honorable Elder of the Hall of Souls, traps him inside a Spiritual Barrier and demands the Flame Mantra and the Bone Chilling Flame. Mu Gu fights with the Sea Heart Flame and nearly takes Xiao Yan's three Heavenly Flames, until Xuan Kong Zi of the Pill Tower sends a split soul to drive him off. Under questioning, Han Feng's soul admits he gave his Sea Heart Flame to Mu Gu, a Dou Zun and eight-tier alchemist who was expelled from Yao Chen's sect and helped plot against Yao Chen. Elder Sheng takes Xiao Yan into the Pill Tower and promises to warn the Profound Xuan Sect, which likely told the Hall of Souls about him. Xuan Kong Zi, the Pill Tower's Chairman and an old friend of Yao Chen, asks to be called Uncle Xuan and gives Xiao Yan the Ten Thousand Year Old Green Spiritual Vine, the Blood Essence Demon Fruit and the Soul Palms scroll. He then asks Xiao Yan, Song Qing and Cao Ying to keep the Hall of Souls out of the Pill Gathering's top ten, because it wants the sealed Three Thousand Burning Flame.
events: Mu Gu traps Xiao Yan in a Spiritual Barrier and demands the Flame Mantra.
Mu Gu overpowers Xiao Yan with the Sea Heart Flame.
Xuan Kong Zi's split soul drives Mu Gu away.
Han Feng's soul reveals Mu Gu's identity and his part in betraying Yao Chen.
Elder Sheng brings Xiao Yan into the Pill Tower and promises to warn the Profound Xuan Sect.
Xuan Kong Zi gives Xiao Yan the two missing herbs and the Soul Palms scroll.
Xiao Yan meets Song Qing, the First Elder's disciple and youngest Pill Tower elder.
Xuan Kong Zi warns that the Hall of Souls is after the Three Thousand Burning Flame.
introduced: First Elder of the Pill Tower
